natural_sampling.base: reuse archived uniform natural256 orders; uniformly insert any newly admitted identities using frozen seeds while preserving archived relative order
natural_sampling.subsets: filter same complete base order by frozen membership, retaining relative order
natural_sampling.legacy_strata: retain archived origin_stratum/path_id, normally old24 + prior_new24 + new104A + new104B; bootstrap each saved stratum separately
natural_sampling.marginal_property: restriction of uniform permutation to a fixed subset is uniform; first k is a uniform k-subset
natural_sampling.repeated_teams: retain multiplicity in MC path estimators; cache endpoints once
natural_sampling.exact_summary: all finite team subsets once with equal weights when completely enumerated; separate from MC path estimate
natural_sampling.small_pool_warning: 256 filtered orders are MC even if all possible orders appeared; empirical multiplicities do not become exact equal weights
natural_sampling.k1: individual raw-answer baseline; exact individual summary may be separately reported
natural_sampling.k2: policy-deferred/independent supplement, not fusion failure and excluded from main simultaneous band

aggregation.supplementary: building-equal, first average images within each building
aggregation.pool_targets: never merge three target pools as independent images
aggregation.p10: within-image path Q P10 then image/building aggregation; not pooled across unequal pool sizes

bootstrap.unit: whole base-image order path across all k and coupled families; preserve origin strata
bootstrap.path_mc_band: fixed images; resample replicate indices jointly for paired curves, preserving missingness and state
bootstrap.building_band: resample buildings with all their images and paired families together; fixed saved path estimates
bootstrap.exact: no artificial MC uncertainty for complete finite expectation; building variation remains if >1 buildings
bootstrap.full_endpoint: same deterministic team repeated on 256 paths is one endpoint; path MC variance is zero
bootstrap.simultaneous: use existing frozen simultaneous-band implementation; pointwise intervals not relabelled simultaneous
bootstrap.one_building: report descriptive case range and path Monte Carlo uncertainty; cannot infer across-building uncertainty
